summary: MariMed Inc. filed a routine Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 on September 23, 2026, disclosing that it filed a definitive Schedule 14A proxy statement for a special meeting of stockholders to approve a reverse stock split of its common stock. No price, stake, premium, acquirer, target or strategic transaction is involved; the board is soliciting proxies for the Reverse Stock Split Proposal. The 8-K also includes a press release as Exhibit 99.1 and standard participant/forward-looking language. Watch for the special meeting date, record date and the reverse-split ratio, but this is not a special situation.
